items.originalTitle: HBO Max is offering one of the best Black Friday deals we’ve seen this year
items.author: Sheena Vasani
items.title: HBO Max is offering one of the best Black Friday deals we’ve seen this year
items.summary: If you’ve been meaning to catch up on Lanterns or the latest season of The Gilded Age , Thanksgiving weekend is the perfect time to do so. And thanks to HBO Max’s new Black Friday deal, new and returning subscribers can now watch both shows for less. The streaming service is currently offering a 50 percent discount for Black Friday , bringing the price of its Basic With Ads plan down to $5.49 per month (about $6 off) for one year. The promotion runs through November 30th, and you can subscribe either via HBO Max or Amazon . HBO Max (one-year) Where to Buy: $10.49 $5.49 at Amazon (monthly, with ads) $10.99 $5.49 at HBO Max (monthly, with ads) HBO Max has plenty of great movies and shows to keep you entertained well into the new year, no matter which plan you choose. You’ll find a wide selection of TV shows, including Heated Rivalry , Dune: Prophecy , The White Lotus , Euphoria , and Knight of the Seven Kingdoms , alongside longtime favorites like Game of Thrones and The Big Bang Theory . There’s more on the way, too, including HBO’s highly anticipated Harry Potter series, which premieres on Christmas . There’s plenty to watch beyond TV, too. HBO Max’s extensive movie catalog currently includes films like Sinners , One Battle After Another , Marty Supreme , Backrooms , and Wuthering Heights . And if you’re a sports fan, both the Standard and Premium plans also include access to select live events from MLB, U.S. Soccer, the NCAA, and more. What you get ultimately depends on the subscription tier you choose. HBO Max’s Basic with Ads plan lets you stream on two devices at once but doesn’t include live sports. The ad-free Standard plan ($18.49 a month), meanwhile, adds live sports and up to 30 offline downloads. The Premium plan ($22.99 a month) adds a few more perks, including 4K streaming and Dolby Atmos with select titles, up to 100 downloads, and the ability to stream movies and shows on four devices simultaneously. That said, HBO currently isn’t offering discounts on either the Standard or Premium plans… at least not yet.

items.originalTitle: Study reveals dual roles for ATRX in nucleosome remodeling and histone chaperoning
items.title: Study reveals dual roles for ATRX in nucleosome remodeling and histone chaperoning
items.summary: ATRX is an ATP-dependent chromatin remodeler that helps maintain genome stability. Mutations in ATRX cause ATR-X syndrome and are found in several types of cancer. ATRX is best known for working with the histone chaperone DAXX to deposit the histone variant H3.3 in heterochromatin, where it helps maintain gene silencing and chromatin integrity. However, how ATRX regulates its own ATPase activity, uses ATP to remodel nucleosomes and functions in accessible chromatin remains unclear.

items.originalTitle: No magnets needed: Extreme voltage drives completely new kind of Hall effect
items.title: No magnets needed: Extreme voltage drives completely new kind of Hall effect
items.summary: The Hall effect, a physical phenomenon in which a current arises perpendicular to a voltage applied across a material, has been of particular interest to physicists since it was discovered more than a century ago. Over time, physicists have broadened their understanding of the Hall effect, describing quantum and anomalous versions that appear under nonclassical conditions. Recently, Rice University's Qimiao Si published a paper in Physical Review Letters describing a new variant called the fully nonequilibrium response that once again expands how physicists understand the Hall effect.

items.summary: Medical experts suspect that high levels of air pollution exacerbate the symptoms of hay fever patients. Researchers at the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry in Mainz (MPIC) have now solved a chemical puzzle: When pollen allergens encounter peroxynitrite, the allergens undergo surprisingly systematic changes. items.title: New fiber laser combines ultrashort pulses with broad spectrum and stable output
items.summary: Femtosecond lasers produce pulses lasting only quadrillionths of a second. Their speed makes them useful for imaging rapid processes, sampling high-frequency signals and measuring distance or time with high precision. For these applications, a laser must provide not only short pulses and a broad spectrum but also stable output. Fluctuations in pulse intensity or timing can reduce image quality and measurement accuracy.

The Select plan lets you stream only TV shows that aired on NBC network channels, including NBC, Bravo, and Telemundo. If you just want to rewatch The Office and Law and Order , or catch new episodes of Below Deck, this plan is for you.
